## Social Fetch - LinkedIn (Company Page, organic posts)

Sub-workflow. Called by **Social Daily Report - Orchestrator**.

Input: `account_id` = the **numeric organization ID** of the company page (not the vanity name), `channel`, `likes_label`, `days`.

### Flow
`Get org posts` (Posts API, finder `author`) -> `Build stats requests` -> `Get share statistics` (organizationalEntityShareStatistics, per-post lifetime counts) -> `Normalize LinkedIn rows`.

Scopes used: `r_organization_social` (list posts) + `rw_organization_admin` (share statistics). The member who connects the credential must be an **ADMINISTRATOR** of the page.

### Credential (do NOT use n8n's built-in "LinkedIn OAuth2 API")
Its scopes are hard-coded (`w_member_social`, `w_organization_social`, profile/openid) and do not include the two read scopes above. Create a generic **OAuth2 API** credential instead:
- Grant Type: Authorization Code
- Authorization URL: `https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization`
- Access Token URL: `https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken`
- Scope: `r_organization_social rw_organization_admin`
- Authentication: **Body** (LinkedIn wants client id/secret in the body)
- Add n8n's OAuth redirect URL to the LinkedIn app's *Authorized redirect URLs*.
Select it on both HTTP nodes -- not stored in this file.

### Heads-up
- Standard LinkedIn apps get **60-day access tokens with no refresh token** -> reconnect the credential every ~60 days (same chore as the old Facebook token) unless LinkedIn has approved your app for refresh tokens.
- `Linkedin-Version` header is set to `202609` on both HTTP nodes; older versions are sunset on a rolling basis, so bump it if LinkedIn ever returns a version error.
- Numbers are lifetime, organic only (no sponsored). Posts with zero impressions/actions are omitted by LinkedIn and treated as 0.
- **Personal profiles (e.g. Brand B) are NOT covered**: listing a member's posts needs `r_member_social` (restricted, approval-only) and `r_member_postAnalytics` only returns per-post numbers for URNs you already know, or aggregate totals.
